Contract ProcessSaleService::makeNewSale(): Boolean {
	precondition:
		CashDesk.allInstances()->exists(cd: CashDesk|cd = self.CurrentCashDesk) and
		self.CurrentCashDesk.IsOpened = true and
		(self.CurrentSale.oclIsUndefined() = true or
		self.CurrentSale.IsComplete = true)
	postcondition:
		result = true and
		Sale.allInstances()->exists(s: Sale|s.oclIsNew() = true and
		s = self.CurrentSale and
		s.IsComplete = false and
		s.IsReadytoPay = false and
		s.BelongedCashDesk = self.CurrentCashDesk and
		self.CurrentCashDesk.ContainedSales->includes(s))
}
